knowledge_graph.title: Immunodeficiency
knowledge_graph.description: Immunodeficiency, also known as immunocompromise, is a state in which the immune system's ability to fight infectious diseases and cancer is compromised or entirely absent. Most cases are acquired due to extrinsic factors that affect the patient's immune system.
